title: At the weekend
subtitle: 주말
review: Written by Claude. The Korean and the romanization have not been checked by a Korean speaker. English support only: no Burmese lines were written.
intro: Two friends talk about what they do at the weekend. Listen for what each of them likes.
steps: Press Play all with the text hidden. Who is speaking, and where are they?
Listen again, then answer the questions under the dialogue.
Tap the lines to show the text, and listen once more while reading.
Shadow it: play a line, press Pause (or the space bar), say it aloud, then Resume.
Take a role and say your lines in the pauses.

tr.en: What do you do at the weekend?
I play football with my friends.
That's nice. Do you like football?
Yes, I love it. And you, Sujin?
What kind of films do you like?
Me too. Let's watch one together sometime.

questions.q: What does Jiho do at the weekend?
questions.why: Chingurang chukgureul haeyo = I play football with friends.
Jibeseo yeonghwareul bwayo = I watch films at home.

questions.q: What kind of films does Sujin like?
questions.why: Komedi yeonghwareul joahaeyo = I like comedies.

notes: [Thing] joahaeyo = I like [thing]. aju joahaeyo = I like it very much.
[Name] ssineunyo? = And you, [name]? ssi is the polite word after a given name.
